23.14: And Jehoiada the priest brings out the heads of the hundreds, inspectors of the force, and says to them, `Take her out from within the rows, and he who has gone after her is put to death by the sword;' for the priest said, `Put her not to death in the house of Jehovah.'
23.15: And they make for her sides, and she comes in to the entrance of the gate of the horses at the house of the king, and they put her to death there.
23.16: And Jehoiada makes a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, to be for a people to Jehovah;
23.17: and all the people enter the house of Baal, and break it down, yes, his altars and his images they have broken, and Mattan priest of Baal they have slain before the altars.
23.18: And Jehoiada puts the offices of the house of Jehovah into the hand of the priests the Levites whom David had apportioned over the house of Jehovah, to cause to ascend the burnt-offerings of Jehovah, as written in the law of Moses, with joy, and with singing, by the hands of David;
23.19: and he stations the gatekeepers over the gates of the house of Jehovah, and the unclean in anything does not go in.
23.20: And he takes the heads of the hundreds, and the honourable ones, and the rulers among the people, and all the people of the land, and brings down the king from the house of Jehovah, and they come in through the high gate to the house of the king, and cause the king to sit on the throne of the kingdom.
23.21: And all the people of the land rejoice, and the city has been quiet, and Athaliah they have put to death by the sword.

24.1: A son of seven years is Joash in his reigning, and forty years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother is Zibiah of Beer-Sheba.
24.2: And Joash does that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
24.3: And Jehoiada takes for him two wives, and he begets sons and daughters.
24.4: And it comes to pass after this, it has been with the heart of Joash to renew the house of Jehovah,
24.5: and he gathers the priests and the Levites, and says to them, `Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather from all Israel money to strengthen the house of your God sufficiently year by year, and you, you do haste to the matter;' and the Levites have not hasted.
24.6: And the king calls for Jehoiada the head, and says to him, `Wherefore have you not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the tribute of Moses, servant of Jehovah, and of the assembly of Israel, for the tent of the testimony?
24.7: for sons of Athaliah, the wicked one, have broken up the house of God, and also, all the holy things of the house of Jehovah they have prepared for Baalim.'
24.8: And the king speaks, and they make one chest, and put it at the gate of the house of Jehovah without,
24.9: and give an intimation in Judah and in Jerusalem to bring in to Jehovah the tribute of Moses, servant of God, laid on Israel in the wilderness.
24.10: And all the heads, and all the people rejoice, and they bring in, and cast into the chest, to completion.
24.11: And it comes to pass, at the time one brings in the chest for the inspection of the king by the hand of the Levites, and at their seeing that the money is abundant, that a scribe of the king has come in, and an officer of the head-priest, and they empty the chest, and take it up and turn it back to its place; thus they have done day by day, and gather money in abundance.
24.12: And the king and Jehoiada give it to the doers of the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and they are hiring hewers and artificers to renew the house of Jehovah, and also--to artificers in iron and brass to strengthen the house of Jehovah.
24.13: And those doing the business work, and there goes up lengthening to the work by their hand, and they establish the house of God, by its proper measure, and strengthen it.
24.14: And at their completing it, they have brought in before the king and Jehoiada the rest of the money, and they make it vessels for the house of Jehovah, vessels of serving, and of offering up, and spoons, even vessels of gold and silver; and they are causing burnt-offerings to ascend in the house of Jehovah continually, all the days of Jehoiada.
24.15: And Jehoiada is aged and satisfied with days, and dies--a son of a hundred and thirty years in his death,
24.16: and they bury him in the city of David, with the kings, for he has done good in Israel, and with God, and his house.
24.17: And after the death of Jehoiada come in have heads of Judah, and bow themselves to the king; then has the king hearkened to them,
24.18: and they forsake the house of Jehovah, God of their fathers, and serve the shrines and the idols, and there is wrath upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their guilt.
24.19: And He sends among them prophets, to bring them back to Jehovah, and they testify against them, and they have not given ear;
24.20: and the Spirit of God has clothed Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stands over-against the people, and says to them, `Thus said God, Why are you transgressing the commands of Jehovah, and prosper not? because you have forsaken Jehovah--He does forsake you.'
24.21: And they conspire against him, and stone him with stones by the command of the king, in the court of the house of Jehovah,
24.22: and Joash the king has not remembered the kindness that Jehoiada his father did with him, and slays his son, and in his death he said, `Jehovah does see, and require.'
24.23: And it comes to pass, at the turn of the year, come up has the force of Aram against him, and they come in to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroy all the heads of the people from the people, and all their spoil they have sent to the king of Damascus,
24.24: for with few men have the force of Aram come in, and Jehovah has given into their hand a mighty force for multitude, because they have forsaken Jehovah, God of their fathers; and with Joash they have executed judgments.
24.25: And in their going from him--for they left him with many diseases--his servants themselves have conspired against him, for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slay him on his bed, and he dies; and they bury him in the city of David, and have not buried him in the graves of the kings.
24.26: And these are those conspiring against him, Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonitess, and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
24.27: As to his sons, and the greatness of the burden upon him, and the foundation of the house of God, indeed, they are written on the `Inquiry' of the book of the Kings; and reign does Amaziah his son in his stead.

25.1: A son of twenty and five years has Amaziah reigned, and twenty and nine years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother is Jehoaddan of Jerusalem,
25.2: and he does that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah--only, not with a perfect heart.
25.3: And it comes to pass, when the kingdom has been strong upon him, that he slays his servants, those smiting the king his father,
25.4: and their sons he has not put to death, but did as is written in the law, in the book of Moses, whom Jehovah commanded, saying, `Fathers do not die for sons, and sons die not for fathers, but each for his own sin they die.'
25.5: And Amaziah gathers Judah, and appoints them, according to the house of the fathers, for heads of the thousands, and for heads of the hundreds, for all Judah and Benjamin; and he inspects them from a son of twenty years and upward, and finds them three hundred thousand chosen ones, going forth to the host, holding spear and target.
25.6: And he hires out of Israel a hundred thousand mighty ones of valour, with a hundred talents of silver;
25.7: and a man of God has come in to him, saying, `O king, the host of Israel does not go with you; for Jehovah is not with Israel--all the sons of Ephraim;
25.8: but if you are going--do it, be strong for battle, God does cause you to stumble before an enemy, for there is power in God to help, and to cause to stumble.'
25.9: And Amaziah says to the man of God, `And what--to do for the hundred talents that I have given to the troop of Israel?' And the man of God says, `Jehovah has more to give to you than this.'
25.10: And Amaziah separates them--for the troop that has come in to him from Ephraim to go to their own place, and their anger does burn mightily against Judah, and they turn back to their place in the heat of anger.
25.11: And Amaziah has strengthened himself, and leads his people, and goes to the Valley of Salt, and smites the sons of Seir--ten thousand.
25.12: And ten thousand alive have the sons of Judah taken captive, and they bring them to the top of the rock, and cast them from the top of the rock, and all of them have been broken.
25.13: And the sons of the troop that Amaziah has sent back from going with him to battle--they rush against cities of Judah, from Samaria even to Beth-Horon, and smite of them three thousand, and seize much prey.
25.14: And it comes to pass, after the coming in of Amaziah from smiting the Edomites, that he brings in the gods of the sons of Seir, and establishes them to him for gods, and before them does bow himself, and to them he makes perfume.
25.15: And the anger of Jehovah burns against Amaziah, and He sends to him a prophet, and he says to him, `Why have you sought the gods of the people that have not delivered their people out of your hand?'
25.16: And it comes to pass, in his speaking to him, that he says to him, `For a counsellor to the king have we appointed you? cease for you; why do they smite you?' And the prophet ceases, and says, `I have known that God has counselled to destroy you, because you have done this, and have not hearkened to my counsel.'
25.17: And Amaziah king of Judah takes counsel, and sends to Joash son of Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying,
25.18: `Come, we look one another in the face.' And Joash king of Israel sends to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, `The thorn that is in Lebanon has sent to the cedar that is in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for a wife; and pass by does a beast of the field that is in Lebanon, and treads down the thorn.
25.19: You have said, Indeed, I have smitten Edom; and your heart has lifted you up to boast; now, abide in your house, why do you stir yourself up in evil, that you have fallen, you, and Judah with you?'
25.20: And Amaziah has not hearkened, for from God it is in order to give them into hand, because they have sought the gods of Edom;
25.21: and go up does Joash king of Israel, and they look one another in the face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, in Beth-Shemesh, that is Judah's,
25.22: and Judah is smitten before Israel, and they flee--each to his tents.
25.23: And Amaziah king of Judah, son of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, has Joash king of Israel caught in Beth-Shemesh, and brings him in to Jerusalem, and breaks down in the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the gate of the corner, four hundred cubits,
25.24: and takes all the gold, and the silver, and all the vessels that are found in the house of God with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the house of the king, and the sons of the pledges, and turns back to Samaria.
25.25: And Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, lives after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years;
25.26: and the rest of the matters of Amaziah, the first and the last, indeed, are they not written on the books of the kings of Judah and Israel?
25.27: And from the time that Amaziah has turned aside from after Jehovah--they make a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he flees to Lachish, and they send after him to Lachish, and put him to death there,
25.28: and lift him up on the horses, and bury him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

26.1: And all the people of Judah take Uzziah (and he is a son of sixteen years), and cause him to reign instead of his father Amaziah.
26.2: He has built Eloth, and restores it to Judah after the king's lying with his fathers.
26.3: A son of sixteen years is Uzziah in his reigning, and fifty and two years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother is Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
26.4: And he does that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that Amaziah his father did,
26.5: and he is as one seeking God in the days of Zechariah who has understanding in visions of God: and in the days of his seeking Jehovah, God has caused him to prosper.
26.6: And he goes forth, and fights with the Philistines, and breaks down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and builds cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
26.7: And God helps him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who are dwelling in Gur-Baal and the Mehunim.
26.8: And the Ammonites give a present to Uzziah, and his name goes to the entering in of Egypt, for he strengthened himself greatly.
26.9: And Uzziah builds towers in Jerusalem, by the gate of the corner, and by the gate of the valley, and by the angle, and strengthens them;
26.10: and he builds towers in the wilderness, and digs many wells, for he had much cattle, both in the low country and in the plain, husbandmen and vine-dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel; for he was a lover of the ground.
26.11: And Uzziah has a force, making war, going forth to the host, by troops, in the number of their reckoning by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Masseiah the officer, by the hand of Hananiah one of the heads of the king.
26.12: The whole number of heads of the fathers of the mighty ones of valour is two thousand and six hundred;
26.13: and by their hand is the force of the host, three hundred thousand, and seven thousand, and five hundred warriors, with mighty power to give help to the king against the enemy.
26.14: And Uzziah prepares for them, for all the host, shields, and spears, and helmets, and coats of mail, and bows, even to stones of the slings.
26.15: And he makes in Jerusalem inventions--a device of an inventor--to be on the towers, and on the corners, to shoot with arrows and with great stones, and his name goes out to a distance, for he has been wonderfully helped till that he has been strong.
26.16: And at his being strong his heart has been high to destruction, and he trespasses against Jehovah his God, and goes in to the temple of Jehovah to make perfume upon the altar of perfume.
26.17: And Azariah the priest goes in after him, and with him priests of Jehovah eighty, sons of valour,
26.18: and they stand up against Uzziah the king, and say to him, `Not for you, O Uzziah, to make perfume to Jehovah, but for priests, sons of Aaron, who are sanctified to make perfume; go forth from the sanctuary, for you have trespassed, and it is not to you for honour from Jehovah God.'
26.19: And Uzziah is wroth, and in his hand is a censer to make perfume, and in his being wroth with the priests--the leprosy has risen in his forehead, before the priests, in the house of Jehovah, from beside the altar of perfume.
26.20: And Azariah the head priest looks to him, and all the priests, and indeed, he is leprous in his forehead, and they hasten him from there, and also he himself has hastened to go out, for Jehovah has plagued him.
26.21: And Uzziah the king is a leper to the day of his death, and inhabits a separate house--a leper, for he has been cut off from the house of Jehovah, and Jotham his son is over the house of the king, judging the people of the land.
26.22: And the rest of the matters of Uzziah, the first and the last, has Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet written;
26.23: and Uzziah lies with his fathers, and they bury him with his fathers, in the field of the burying-place that the kings have, for they said, `He is a leper;' and reign does Jotham his son in his stead.

27.1: A son of twenty and five years is Jotham in his reigning, and sixteen years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother is Jerushah daughter of Zadok.
27.2: And he does that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that Uzziah his father did; only, he has not come in to the temple of Jehovah; and again are the people doing corruptly.
27.3: He has built the upper gate of the house of Jehovah, and in the wall of Ophel he has built abundantly;
27.4: and cities he has built in the hill-country of Judah, and in the forests he has built palaces and towers.
27.5: And he has fought with the king of the sons of Ammon, and prevails over them, and the sons of Ammon give to him in that year a hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand cors of wheat, and of barley ten thousand; this have the sons of Ammon returned to him both in the second year, and in the third.
27.6: And Jotham does strengthen himself, for he has prepared his ways before Jehovah his God.
27.7: And the rest of the matters of Jotham, and all his battles, and his ways, indeed, they are written on the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
27.8: A son of twenty and five years was he in his reigning, and sixteen years he has reigned in Jerusalem;
27.9: and Jotham lies with his fathers, and they bury him in the city of David, and reign does Ahaz his son in his stead.

28.1: A son of twenty years is Ahaz in his reigning, and sixteen years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and he has not done that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah, as David his father,
28.2: and walks in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also, molten images has made for Baalim,
28.3: and himself has made perfume in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burns his sons with fire according to the abominations of the nations that Jehovah dispossessed from the presence of the sons of Israel,
28.4: and sacrifices and makes perfume in high places, and on the heights, and under every green tree.
28.5: And Jehovah his God gives him into the hand of the king of Aram, and they smite him, and take captive from him a great captivity, and bring them in to Damascus, and also into the hand of the king of Israel he has been given, and he smites him--a great smiting.
28.6: And Pekah son of Remaliah slays in Judah a hundred and twenty thousand in one day (the whole are sons of valour), because of their forsaking Jehovah, God of their fathers.
28.7: And Zichri, a mighty one of Ephraim, slays Maaseiah son of the king, and Azrikam leader of the house, and Elkanah second to the king.
28.8: And the sons of Israel take captive of their brethren, two hundred thousand, wives, sons and daughters, and also much spoil they have seized from them, and they bring in the spoil to Samaria.
28.9: And there has been there a prophet of Jehovah (Oded is his name), and he goes out before the host that has come in to Samaria, and says to them, `Indeed, in the fury of Jehovah God of your fathers against Judah, He has given them into your hand, and you slay among them in rage--to the heavens it has come;
28.10: and now, sons of Judah and Jerusalem you are saying to subdue for men-servants and for maid-servants to you; but are there not with you causes of guilt before Jehovah your God?
28.11: and now, hear me, and send back the captives whom you have taken captive of your brethren, for the heat of the anger of Jehovah is upon you.'
28.12: And certain of the heads of the sons of Ephraim (Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai), rise up against those coming in from the host,
28.13: and say to them, `You do not bring in the captives here, for, to guilt against Jehovah on us, you are saying to add to our sin and to our guilt? for abundant is the guilt we have, and the fierceness of anger on Israel.'
28.14: And the armed men leave the captives and the prey before the heads and all the assembly;
28.15: and the men who have been expressed by name rise and take hold on the captives, and all their naked ones they have clothed from the spoil, yes, they clothe them, and shoe them, and cause them to eat and drink, and anoint them, and lead them on asses, even every feeble one, and bring them in to Jericho, the city of palms, near their brethren, and turn back to Samaria.
28.16: At that time has king Ahaz sent to the king of Asshur to give help to him;
28.17: and again the Edomites have come, and smite in Judah, and take captive a captivity.
28.18: And the Philistines have rushed against the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and capture Beth-Shemesh, and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho and its villages, and Timnah and its villages, and Gimzo and its villages, and dwell there,
28.19: for Jehovah has humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he made free with Judah, even to commit a trespass against Jehovah.
28.20: And Tilgath-Pilneser king of Asshur comes in to him, and does distress him, and has not strengthened him,
28.21: though Ahaz has taken a portion out of the house of Jehovah, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gives to the king of Asshur, yet it is no help to him.
28.22: And in the time of his distress--he adds to trespass against Jehovah, (this king Ahaz),
28.23: and he sacrifices to the gods of Damascus--those smiting him, and says, `Because the gods of the kings of Aram are helping them, to them I sacrifice, and they help me,' and they have been to him to cause him to stumble, and to all Israel.
28.24: And Ahaz gathers the vessels of the house of God, and cuts in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shuts the doors of the house of Jehovah, and makes to himself altars in every corner in Jerusalem.
28.25: And in every city and city of Judah he has made high places to make perfume to other gods, and provokes Jehovah, God of his fathers.
28.26: And the rest of his matters, and all his ways, the first and the last, indeed, they are written on the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
28.27: And Ahaz lies with his fathers, and they bury him in the city, in Jerusalem, but have not brought him in to the graves of the kings of Israel, and reign does Hezekiah his son in his stead.

29.1: Hezekiah has reigned--a son of twenty and five years, and twenty and nine years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother is Abijah daughter of Zechariah;
29.2: and he does that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that David his father did.
29.3: He, in the first year of his reign, in the first month, has opened the doors of the house of Jehovah, and strengthens them,
29.4: and brings in the priests and the Levites, and gathers them to the broad place to the east.
29.5: And he says to them, `Hear me, O Levites, now, sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Jehovah, God of your fathers, and bring out the impurity from the sanctuary,
29.6: for our fathers have trespassed, and done that which is evil in the eyes of Jehovah our God, and forsake him, and turn round their faces from the tabernacle of Jehovah, and give the neck.
29.7: `Also--they have shut the doors of the porch, and quench the lamps, and perfume they have not made, and burnt-offering have not caused to ascend in the sanctuary to the God of Israel,
29.8: and the wrath of Jehovah is on Judah and Jerusalem, and He gives them for a trembling, for an astonishment, and for a hissing, as you are seeing with your eyes.
29.9: And indeed, fallen have our fathers by the sword, and our sons, and our daughters, and our wives are in captivity for this.
29.10: `Now--with my heart--to make a covenant before Jehovah, God of Israel, and the fierceness of His anger does turn back from us.
29.11: My sons, be not now at rest, for on you has Jehovah fixed to stand before Him, to serve Him, and to be to Him ministering and making perfume.'
29.12: And the Levites rise--Mahath son of Amasai, and Joel son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathite; and of the sons of Merari: Kish son of Abdi, and Azariah son of Jehalelel; and of the Gershonite: Joah son of Zimmah, and Eden son of Joah;
29.13: and of the sons of Elizaphan: Shimri, and Jeiel; and of the sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah;
29.14: and of the sons of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel--
29.15: and they gather their brethren, and sanctify themselves, and come in, according to the command of the king in the matters of Jehovah, to cleanse the house of Jehovah,
29.16: and the priests come in to the inner part of the house of Jehovah to cleanse it, and bring out all the uncleanness that they have found in the temple of Jehovah to the court of the house of Jehovah, and the Levites receive it, to take it out to the brook Kidron without.
29.17: And they begin on the first of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they have come to the porch of Jehovah, and they sanctify the house of Jehovah in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they have finished.
29.18: And they come in within to Hezekiah the king, and say, `We have cleansed all the house of Jehovah, and the altar of the burnt-offering, and all its vessels, and the table of the arrangement, and all its vessels,
29.19: and all the vessels that king Ahaz cast away in his reign--in his trespass--we have prepared and sanctified, and indeed, they are before the altar of Jehovah.'
29.20: And Hezekiah the king rises early, and gathers the heads of the city, and goes up to the house of Jehovah;
29.21: and they bring in seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven young he-goats, for a sin-offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah; and he says to sons of Aaron, the priests, to cause them to ascend on the altar of Jehovah.
29.22: And they slaughter the oxen, and the priests receive the blood, and sprinkle on the altar; and they slaughter the rams, and sprinkle the blood on the altar; and they slaughter the lambs, and sprinkle the blood on the altar;
29.23: and they bring nigh the he-goats of the sin-offering before the king and the assembly, and they lay their hands upon them;
29.24: and the priests slaughter them, and make a sin-offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel, for `For all Israel,' said the king, ` is the burnt-offering and the sin-offering.'
29.25: And he appoints the Levites in the house of Jehovah with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, by the command of David, and of Gad, seer of the king, and of Nathan the prophet, for by the hand of Jehovah is the command, by the hand of His prophets;
29.26: and the Levites stand with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
29.27: And Hezekiah says to cause the burnt-offering to ascend on the altar; and at the time the burnt-offering began--began the song of Jehovah, and the trumpets, even by the hands of the instruments of David king of Israel.
29.28: And all the assembly are doing obeisance, and the singers singing, and the trumpeters blowing; the whole is till the completion of the burnt-offering.
29.29: And at the completion of the offering up bowed have the king and all those found with him, and do obeisance.
29.30: And Hezekiah the king says, and the princes, to the Levites to give praise to Jehovah in the words of David, and of Asaph the seer, and they praise--to joy, and they bow, and do obeisance.
29.31: And Hezekiah answers and says, `Now you have filled your hand to Jehovah, come nigh, and bring in sacrifices and thank-offerings to the house of Jehovah;' and the assembly bring in sacrifices and thank-offerings, and every willing-hearted one--burnt-offerings.
29.32: And the number of the burnt-offerings that the assembly have brought in, is seventy oxen, a hundred rams, lambs two hundred; for a burnt-offering to Jehovah are all these.
29.33: And the sanctified things are oxen six hundred, and sheep three thousand.
29.34: Only, the priests have become few, and have not been able to strip the whole of the burnt-offerings, and their brethren the Levites strengthen them till the completion of the work, and till the priests sanctify themselves, for the Levites are more upright of heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
29.35: And also, burnt-offerings are in abundance, with fat of the peace-offerings, and with oblations for the burnt-offering; and the service of the house of Jehovah is established,
29.36: and rejoice does Hezekiah and all the people, because of God's giving preparation to the people, for the thing has been suddenly.

30.1: And Hezekiah sends to all Israel and Judah, and also letters he has written to Ephraim and Manasseh, to come in to the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem, to make a passover to Jehovah, God of Israel.
30.2: And the king takes counsel, and his heads, and all the assembly in Jerusalem, to make the passover in the second month,
30.3: for they have not been able to make it at that time, for the priests have not sanctified themselves sufficiently, and the people have not been gathered to Jerusalem.
30.4: And the thing is right in the eyes of the king, and in the eyes of all the assembly,
30.5: and they establish the thing, to cause to pass over an intimation into all Israel, from Beer-Sheba even to Dan, to come in to make a passover to Jehovah, God of Israel, in Jerusalem, for not for a long time had they done as it is written.
30.6: And the runners go with letters from the hand of the king and his heads, into all Israel and Judah, even according to the command of the king, saying, `O sons of Israel, turn back to Jehovah, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and He does turn back to the escaped part that is left of you from the hand of the kings of Asshur;
30.7: and do not be like your fathers, and like your brethren, who trespassed against Jehovah, God of their fathers, and He gives them to desolation, as you do see.
30.8: `Now, harden not your neck like your fathers, give a hand to Jehovah, and come in to His sanctuary, that He has sanctified to the age, and serve Jehovah your God, and the fierceness of His anger does turn back from you;
30.9: for in your turning back to Jehovah, your brethren and your sons have mercies before their captors, even to return to this land, for gracious and merciful is Jehovah your God, and He does not turn aside the face from you, if you turn back to Him.'
30.10: And the runners are passing over from city to city, in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun: and they are laughing at them, and mocking at them,
30.11: only, certain from Asher, and Manasseh, and from Zebulun, have been humbled, and come in to Jerusalem.
30.12: Also, in Judah has the hand of God been to give to them one heart to do the command of the king and of the heads, in the matter of Jehovah;
30.13: and much people are gathered to Jerusalem, to make the feast of unleavened things in the second month--a mighty assembly for multitude.
30.14: And they arise and turn aside the altars that are in Jerusalem, and all the perfume altars they have turned aside, and cast them to the brook Kidron;
30.15: and they slaughter the passover-offering on the fourteenth of the second month, and the priests and the Levites have been ashamed, and sanctify themselves, and bring in burnt-offerings to the house of Jehovah.
30.16: And they stand on their station according to their ordinance; according to the law of Moses the man of God the priests are sprinkling the blood out of the hand of the Levites,
30.17: for many are in the assembly who have not sanctified themselves, and the Levites are over the slaughtering of the passover-offerings for every one not clean, to sanctify him to Jehovah:
30.18: for a multitude of the people, many from Ephraim and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, have not been cleansed, but have eaten the passover otherwise than it is written; but Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, `Jehovah, who is good, does receive atonement for every one
30.19: who has prepared his heart to seek God--Jehovah, God of his fathers--yet not according to the cleansing of the sanctuary;'
30.20: and Jehovah hearkens to Hezekiah, and heals the people.
30.21: And the sons of Israel, those found in Jerusalem, make the feast of unleavened things seven days with great joy; and giving praise to Jehovah day by day are the Levites and the priests, with instruments of praise before Jehovah.
30.22: And Hezekiah speaks to the heart of all the Levites, those giving good understanding concerning Jehovah, and they eat the appointed thing seven days; sacrificing sacrifices of peace-offerings, and making confession to Jehovah, God of their fathers.
30.23: And all the assembly take counsel to keep other seven days, and they keep seven days with joy;
30.24: for Hezekiah king of Judah has presented to the assembly a thousand bullocks, and seven thousand sheep; and the heads have presented to the assembly bullocks a thousand, and sheep ten thousand; and priests sanctify themselves in abundance.
30.25: And all the assembly of Judah rejoice, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the assembly, those coming in from Israel, and the sojourners, those coming in from the land of Israel, and those dwelling in Judah,
30.26: and there is great joy in Jerusalem; for from the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there is not like this in Jerusalem,
30.27: and the priests, the Levites, rise and bless the people, and their voice is heard, and their prayer comes in to His holy habitation, to the heavens.

31.1: And at the completion of all this, gone out have all Israel who are found present to the cities of Judah, and break the standing-pillars, and cut down the shrines, and break down the high places and the altars, out of all Judah and Benjamin, and in Ephraim and Manasseh, even to completion, and all the sons of Israel turn back, each to his Possession, to their cities.
31.2: And Hezekiah appoints the courses of the priests, and of the Levites, by their courses, each according to his service, of the priests and of the Levites, for burnt-offering, and for peace-offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to give praise in the gates of the camps of Jehovah.
31.3: And a portion of the king, from his substance, is for burnt-offerings, for burnt-offerings of the morning, and of the evening, and the burnt-offerings of sabbaths, and of new moons, and of appointed seasons, as it is written in the law of Jehovah.
31.4: And he says to the people, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to give the portion of the priests, and of the Levites, so that they are strengthened in the law of Jehovah;
31.5: and at the spreading forth of the thing have the sons of Israel multiplied the first-fruit of corn, new wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field, and the tithe of the whole in abundance they have brought in.
31.6: And the sons of Israel and Judah, those dwelling in cities of Judah, they also a tithe of herd and flock, and a tithe of the holy things that are sanctified to Jehovah their God, have brought in, and they give--heaps, heaps;
31.7: in the third month they have begun to lay the foundation of the heaps, and in the seventh month they have finished.
31.8: And Hezekiah and the heads come in and see the heaps, and bless Jehovah and His people Israel,
31.9: and Hezekiah inquires at the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps,
31.10: and Azariah the head priest, of the house of Zadok, speaks to him, and says, `From the beginning of the bringing of the heave-offering to the house of Jehovah, there is to eat, and to be satisfied, and to leave abundantly, for Jehovah has blessed His people, and that left is this store.'
31.11: And Hezekiah says to prepare chambers in the house of Jehovah, and they prepare,
31.12: and they bring in the heave-offering, and the tithe, and the holy things faithfully; and over them is a leader, Conaniah the Levite, and Shimei his brother is second;
31.13: and Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, are inspectors under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah leader of the house of God.
31.14: And Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east, is over the willing-offerings of God, to give the heave-offering of Jehovah, and the most holy things.
31.15: And by his hand are Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shechaniah, in cities of the priests, faithfully to give to their brethren in courses, as the great so the small,
31.16: apart from their genealogy, to males from a son of three years and upward, to every one who has gone in to the house of Jehovah, by the matter of a day in its day, for their service in their charges, according to their courses;
31.17: and the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and of the Levites, from a son of twenty years and upward, in their charges, in their courses;
31.18: and to the genealogy among all their infants, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters to all the congregation, for in their faithfulness they sanctify themselves in holiness.
31.19: And to sons of Aaron, the priests, in the fields of the suburb of their cities, in every city and city, are men who have been defined by name, to give portions to every male among the priests, and to every one who reckoned himself by genealogy among the Levites.
31.20: And Hezekiah does thus in all Judah, and does that which is good, and that which is right, and that which is true, before Jehovah his God;
31.21: and in every work that he has begun for the service of the house of God, and for the law, and for the command, to seek to his God, with all his heart he has worked and prospered.

32.1: After these things and this truth, come has Sennacherib king of Asshur, yes, he comes in to Judah, and encamps against the cities of the bulwarks, and says to rend them to himself.
32.2: And Hezekiah sees that Sennacherib has come, and his face is to the battle against Jerusalem,
32.3: and he takes counsel with his heads and his mighty ones, to stop the waters of the fountains that are at the outside of the city--and they help him,
32.4: and much people are gathered, and they stop all the fountains and the brook that is rushing into the midst of the land, saying, `Why do the kings of Asshur come, and have found much water?'
32.5: And he strengthens himself, and builds the whole of the wall that is broken, and causes it to ascend to the towers, and at the outside of the wall another, and strengthens Millo, in the city of David, and makes darts in abundance, and shields.
32.6: And he puts heads of war over the people, and gathers them to him, to the broad place of a gate of the city, and speaks to their heart, saying,
32.7: `Be strong and courageous, be not afraid, nor be cast down from the face of the king of Asshur, and from the face of all the multitude that is with him, for with us are more than with him.
32.8: With him is an arm of flesh, and with us is Jehovah our God, to help us, and to fight our battles;' and the people are supported by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
32.9: After this has Sennacherib king of Asshur sent his servants to Jerusalem--and he is by Lachish, and all his power with him--against Hezekiah king of Judah, and against all Judah, who are in Jerusalem, saying,
32.10: `Thus said Sennacherib king of Asshur, On what are you trusting and abiding in the bulwark, in Jerusalem?
32.11: `Is not Hezekiah persuading you, to give you up to die by famine, and by thirst, saying, Jehovah our God does deliver us from the hand of the king of Asshur?
32.12: Has not Hezekiah himself turned aside His high places, and His altars, and speaks to Judah and to Jerusalem, saying, Before one altar you bow yourselves, and on it you make perfume?
32.13: `Do you not know what I have done--I and my fathers--to all peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of the lands at all able to deliver their land out of my hand?
32.14: Who among all the gods of these nations whom my fathers have devoted to destruction is he who has been able to deliver his people out of my hand, that your God is able to deliver you out of my hand?
32.15: `And, now, let not Hezekiah lift you up, nor persuade you thus, nor give credence to him, for no god of any nation and kingdom is able to deliver his people from my hand, and from the hand of my fathers: also, surely your God does not deliver you from my hand!'
32.16: And again have his servants spoken against Jehovah God, and against Hezekiah His servant,
32.17: and letters he has written to give reproach to Jehovah, God of Israel, and to speak against Him, saying, `As the gods of the nations of the lands that have not delivered their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah does not deliver His people from my hand.'
32.18: And they call with a great voice in Jewish, against the people of Jerusalem who are on the wall, to frighten them, and to trouble them, that they may capture the city,
32.19: and they speak against the God of Jerusalem as against the gods of the peoples of the land--work of the hands of man.
32.20: And Hezekiah the king prays, and Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet, concerning this, and they cry to the heavens,
32.21: and Jehovah sends a messenger, and cuts off every mighty one of valour--both leader and head--in the camp of the king of Asshur, and he turns back with shame of face to his land, and enters the house of his god, and those coming out of his bowels have caused him to fall there by the sword.
32.22: And Jehovah saves Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib king of Asshur, and from the hand of all, and He leads them round about;
32.23: and many are bringing in an offering to Jehovah, to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, and he is lifted up before the eyes of all the nations after this.
32.24: In those days has Hezekiah been sick even to death, and he prays to Jehovah, and He speaks to him, and a wonder has appointed for him;
32.25: and Hezekiah has not returned according to the deed done to him, for his heart has been lofty, and there is wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem;
32.26: and Hezekiah is humbled for the loftiness of his heart, he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the wrath of Jehovah has not come upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
32.27: And Hezekiah has riches and honour very much, and treasures he has made to himself of silver, and of gold, and of precious stone, and of spices, and of shields, and of all kinds of desirable vessels,
32.28: and storehouses for the increase of corn, and new wine, and oil, and stalls for all kinds of cattle, and herds for stalls;
32.29: and cities he has made for himself, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance, for God has given to him very much substance.
32.30: And Hezekiah himself has stopped the upper source of the waters of Gihon, and directs them beneath to the west of the city of David, and Hezekiah prospers in all his work;
32.31: and so with the ambassadors of the heads of Babylon, those sending to him to inquire of the wonder that has been in the land, God has left him to try him, to know all in his heart,
32.32: And the rest of the matters of Hezekiah, and his kind acts, indeed, they are written in the vision of Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet, on the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
32.33: And Hezekiah lies with his fathers, and they bury him in the uppermost of the graves of the sons of David, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem have done honour to him at his death, and reign does Manasseh his son in his stead.

33.1: A son of twelve years is Manasseh in his reigning, and fifty and five years he has reigned in Jerusalem;
33.2: and he does the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, like the abominations of the nations that Jehovah dispossessed from the presence of the sons of Israel,
33.3: and he turns and builds the high places that Hezekiah his father has broken down, and raises altars for Baalim, and makes shrines, and bows himself to all the host of the heavens, and serves them.
33.4: And he has built altars in the house of Jehovah of which Jehovah had said, `In Jerusalem is My name to the age.'
33.5: And he builds altars to all the host of the heavens in the two courts of the house of Jehovah.
33.6: And he has caused his sons to pass over through fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and observed clouds and used enchantments and witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and a wizard; he has multiplied to do the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger.
33.7: And he places the graven image of the idol that he made in the house of God, of which God said to David, and to Solomon his son, `In this house, and in Jerusalem that I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I put My name to the age,
33.8: and I add not to turn aside the foot of Israel from off the ground that I appointed to your fathers, only, if they watch to do all that I have commanded them--to all the law, and the statutes, and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.'
33.9: And Manasseh makes Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, to do evil above the nations that Jehovah destroyed from the presence of the sons of Israel.
33.10: And Jehovah speaks to Manasseh and to his people, and they have not attended,
33.11: and Jehovah brings in against them the heads of the host that the king of Asshur has, and they capture Manasseh among the thickets, and bind him with brazen fetters, and cause him to go to Babylon.
33.12: And when he is in distress he has appeased the face of Jehovah his God, and is humbled exceedingly before the God of his fathers,
33.13: and prays to Him, and He is entreated of him, and hears his supplication, and brings him back to Jerusalem, to his kingdom, and Manasseh knows that Jehovah--He is God.
33.14: And after this he has built an outer wall to the city of David, on the west of Gihon, in the valley, and at the entering in at the fish-gate, and it has gone round to the tower, and he makes it exceeding high, and he puts heads of the force in all the cities of the bulwarks in Judah.
33.15: And he turns aside the gods of the stranger, and the idol, out of the house of Jehovah, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of Jehovah and in Jerusalem, and casts them to the outside of the city.
33.16: And he builds the altar of Jehovah, and sacrifices upon it sacrifices of peace-offerings and thank-offering, and says to Judah to serve Jehovah, God of Israel;
33.17: but still the people are sacrificing in high places, only--to Jehovah their God.
33.18: And the rest of the matters of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the matters of the seers, those speaking to him in the name of Jehovah, God of Israel, indeed, they are on the book of the matters of the kings of Israel;
33.19: and his prayer, and his entreaty, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places in which he had built high places, and established the shrines and the graven images before his being humbled, indeed, they are written beside the matters of Hozai.
33.20: And Manasseh lies with his fathers, and they bury him in his own house, and reign does Amon his son in his stead.
33.21: A son of twenty and two years is Amon in his reigning, and two years he has reigned in Jerusalem,
33.22: and he does the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, as did Manasseh his father, and to all the graven images that Manasseh his father had made has Amon sacrificed, and serves them,
33.23: and has not been humbled before Jehovah, like the humbling of Manasseh his father, for Amon himself has multiplied guilt.
33.24: And his servants conspire against him, and put him to death in his own house,
33.25: and the people of the land smite all those conspiring against king Amon, and the people of the land cause Josiah his son to reign in his stead.

34.1: A son of eight years is Josiah in his reigning, and thirty and one years he has reigned in Jerusalem,
34.2: and he does that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah, and walks in the ways of David his father, and has not turned aside--right or left.
34.3: And in the eighth year of his reign (and he yet a youth), he has begun to seek to the God of David his father, and in the twelfth year he has begun to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the shrines, and the graven images, and the molten images.
34.4: And they break down before him the altars of the Baalim, and the images that are on high above them he has cut down, and the shrines, and the graven images, and the molten images, he has broken and beaten small, and streweth on the surface of the graves of those sacrificing to them,
34.5: and the bones of the priests he has burnt on their altars, and cleanses Judah and Jerusalem,
34.6: and in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, with their tools, round about.
34.7: And he breaks down the altars and the shrines, and the graven images he has beaten down very small, and all the images he has cut down in all the land of Israel, and turns back to Jerusalem.
34.8: And in the eighteenth year of his reign, to purify the land and the house he has sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah head of the city, and Joah son of Johaz the remembrancer, to strengthen the house of Jehovah his God.
34.9: And they come in to Hilkiah the high priest, and they give the money that is brought in to the house of God, that the Levites, keeping the threshold, have gathered from the hand of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and from all the remnant of Israel, and from all Judah, and Benjamin, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
34.10: and they give it into the hand of the workmen, those appointed over the house of Jehovah, and they give it to the workmen who are working in the house of Jehovah, to repair and to strengthen the house;
34.11: and they give it to artificers, and to builders, to buy hewn stones, and wood for couplings and for beams to the houses that the kings of Judah had destroyed.
34.12: And the men are working faithfully in the business, and over them are appointed Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathite, to overlook; and of the Levites, every one understanding about instruments of song,
34.13: and over the burden-bearers, and overseers of every one doing work for service and service; and of the Levites are scribes, and officers, and gatekeepers.
34.14: And in their bringing out the money that is brought in to the house of Jehovah, has Hilkiah the priest found the book of the law of Jehovah by the hand of Moses,
34.15: and Hilkiah answers and says to Shaphan the scribe, `A book of the law I have found in the house of Jehovah;' and Hilkiah gives the book to Shaphan,
34.16: and Shaphan brings in the book to the king, and brings the king back word again, saying, `All that has been given into the hand of your servants they are doing,
34.17: and they pour out the money that is found in the house of Jehovah, and give it into the hand of those appointed, and into the hands of those doing the work.'
34.18: And Shaphan the scribe declares to the king, saying, `A book has Hilkiah the priest given to me;' and Shaphan reads in it before the king.
34.19: And it comes to pass, at the king's hearing the words of the law, that he rends his garments,
34.20: and the king commands Hilkiah, and Ahikam son of Shaphan, and Abdon son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah, servant of the king, saying,
34.21: `Go, seek Jehovah for me, and for him who is left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found, for great is the fury of Jehovah that is poured on us, because that our fathers kept not the word of Jehovah, to do according to all that is written on this book.'
34.22: And Hilkiah goes, and they of the king, to Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum son of Tikvath, son of Hasrah, keeper of the garments, and she is dwelling in Jerusalem in the Second, and they speak to her thus.
34.23: And she says to them, `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Say to the man who has sent you to me,
34.24: Thus said Jehovah, Indeed, I am bringing in evil on this place, and on its inhabitants, all the execrations that are written on the book that they read before the king of Judah;
34.25: because that they have forsaken Me, and make perfume to other gods, so as to provoke Me with all the works of their hands, and poured out is My fury upon this place, and it is not quenched.
34.26: `And to the king of Judah, who is sending you to inquire of Jehovah, thus do you say to him: Thus said Jehovah God of Israel, whose words you have heard:
34.27: Because your heart is tender, and you are humbled before God in your hearing His words concerning this place, and concerning its inhabitants, and are humbled before Me, and do rend your garments, and weep before Me: even I also have heard--the affirmation of Jehovah.
34.28: Indeed, I am gathering you to your fathers, and you have been gathered to your graves in peace, and your eyes do not look on all the evil that I am bringing upon this place, and upon its inhabitants;' and they bring the king back word.
34.29: And the king sends and gathers all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem,
34.30: and the king goes up to the house of Jehovah, and every man of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, even all the people, from great even to small, and he reads in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that is found in the house of Jehovah.
34.31: And the king stands on his station, and makes the covenant before Jehovah, to walk after Jehovah, and to keep His commands, and His testimonies, and His statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to do the words of the covenant that are written on this book.
34.32: And he presents every one who is found in Jerusalem and Benjamin, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem do according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
34.33: And Josiah turns aside all the abominations out of all the lands that the sons of Israel have, and causes every one who is found in Israel to serve, to serve Jehovah their God; all his days they turned not aside from after Jehovah, God of their fathers.

35.1: And Josiah makes in Jerusalem a passover to Jehovah, and they slaughter the passover-offering on the fourteenth of the first month,
35.2: and he stations the priests over their charges, and strengthens them for the service of the house of Jehovah,
35.3: and says to the Levites--who are teaching all Israel--who are sanctified to Jehovah, `Put the holy ark in the house that Solomon son of David king of Israel built; it is not to you a burden on the shoulder. `Now, serve Jehovah your God, and His people Israel,
35.4: and prepare, by the house of your fathers, according to your courses, by the writing of David king of Israel, and by the writing of Solomon his son,
35.5: and stand in the sanctuary, by the divisions of the house of the fathers of your brethren, sons of the people, and the portion of the house of a father of the Levites,
35.6: and slaughter the passover-offering and sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brethren, to do according to the word of Jehovah by the hand of Moses.'
35.7: And Josiah lifts up to the sons of the people a flock of lambs and young goats, the whole for passover-offerings, for every one who is found, to the number of thirty thousand, and oxen three thousand: these are from the substance of the king.
35.8: And his heads, for a willing-offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites, have lifted up; Hilkiah, and Zechariah, and Jehiel, leaders in the house of God, to the priests have given for passover-offerings two thousand and six hundred, and oxen three hundred;
35.9: and Conaniah, and Shemaiah, and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah, and Jeiel, and Jozabad, heads of the Levites, have lifted up to the Levites, for passover-offerings, five thousand, and oxen five hundred.
35.10: And the service is prepared, and the priests stand on their station, and the Levites on their courses, according to the command of the king,
35.11: and they slaughter the passover-offering, and the priests sprinkle out of their hand, and the Levites are striping;
35.12: and they turn aside the burnt-offering, to put them by the divisions of the house of the fathers of the sons of the people, to bring near to Jehovah, as it is written in the book of Moses--and so to the oxen.
35.13: And they cook the passover with fire, according to the ordinance, and the sanctified things they have cooked in pots, and in kettles, and in pans--for all the sons of the people.
35.14: And afterward they have prepared for themselves, and for the priests: for the priests, sons of Aaron, are in the offering up of the burnt-offering and of the fat till night; and the Levites have prepared for themselves, and for the priests, sons of Aaron.
35.15: And the singers, sons of Asaph, are on their station, according to the command of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun seer of the king, and the gate keepers are at gate and gate; it is not for them to turn aside from off their service, for their brethren the Levites have prepared for them.
35.16: And all the service of Jehovah is prepared on that day, to keep the passover, and to cause to ascend burnt-offering upon the altar of Jehovah, according to the command of king Josiah.
35.17: And the sons of Israel who are found make the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened things, seven days.
35.18: And there has not been made a passover like it in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, and none of the kings of Israel made such a passover as Josiah has made, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who are found, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
35.19: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah has this passover been made.
35.20: After all this, when Josiah has prepared the house, come up has Necho king of Egypt, to fight against Carchemish by Phrat, and Josiah goes forth to meet him;
35.21: and he sends to him messengers, saying, `What--to me and to you, O king of Judah? not against you do I come to-day, but to the house with which I have war, and God said to haste me; cease for you from God who is with me, and He does not destroy you.'
35.22: And Josiah has not turned round his face from him, but to fight against him has disguised himself, and has not hearkened to the words of Necho, from the mouth of God, and comes in to fight in the valley of Megiddo;
35.23: and the archers shoot at king Josiah, and the king says to his servants, `Remove me, for I have become very sick.'
35.24: And his servants remove him from the chariot, and cause him to ride on the second chariot that he has, and cause him to go to Jerusalem, and he dies, and is buried in the graves of his fathers, and all Judah and Jerusalem are mourning for Josiah,
35.25: and Jeremiah laments for Josiah, and all the singers and the songstresses speak in their lamentations of Josiah to this day, and set them for a statute on Israel, and indeed, they are written beside the lamentations.
35.26: And the rest of the matters of Josiah, and his kind acts, according as it is written in the law of Jehovah,
35.27: even his matters, the first and the last, indeed, they are written on the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

36.1: And the people of the land take Jehoahaz son of Josiah, and cause him to reign instead of his father in Jerusalem.
36.2: A son of three and twenty years is Jehoahaz in his reigning, and three months he has reigned in Jerusalem,
36.3: and turn him aside does the king of Egypt in Jerusalem, and fines the land a hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold;
36.4: and the king of Egypt causes Eliakim his brother to reign over Judah and Jerusalem, and turns his name to Jehoiakim; and Jehoahaz his brother has Necho taken, and brings him in to Egypt.
36.5: A son of twenty and five years is Jehoiakim in his reigning, and eleven years he has reigned in Jerusalem, and he does the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah his God;
36.6: against him has Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come up, and binds him in brazen fetters to take him away to Babylon.
36.7: And of the vessels of the house of Jehovah has Nebuchadnezzar brought in to Babylon, and puts them in his temple in Babylon.
36.8: And the rest of the matters of Jehoiakim, and his abominations that he has done, and that which is found against him, indeed, they are written on the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, and reign does Jehoiachin his son in his stead.
36.9: A son of eight years is Jehoiachin in his reigning, and three months and ten days he has reigned in Jerusalem, and he does the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah;
36.10: and at the turn of the year has king Nebuchadnezzar sent and brings him in to Babylon, with the desirable vessels of the house of Jehovah, and causes Zedekiah his brother to reign over Judah and Jerusalem.
36.11: A son of twenty and one years is Zedekiah in his reigning, and eleven years he has reigned in Jerusalem;
36.12: and he does the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah his God, he has not been humbled before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of Jehovah;
36.13: and also, against king Nebuchadnezzar he has rebelled, who had caused him to swear by God, and he hardens his neck, and strengthens his heart, against turning back to Jehovah, God of Israel.
36.14: Also, all the heads of the priests, and the people, having multiplied to commit a trespass according to all the abominations of the nations, and they defile the house of Jehovah that He has sanctified in Jerusalem.
36.15: And Jehovah, God of their fathers, sends to them by the hand of His messengers--rising early and sending--for He has had pity on His people, and on His habitation,
36.16: and they are mocking at the messengers of God, and despising His words, and acting deceitfully with His prophets, till the going up of the fury of Jehovah against His people--till there is no healing.
36.17: And He causes to go up against them the king of the Chaldeans, and he slays their chosen ones by the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and has had no pity on young man and virgin, old man and very aged--the whole He has given into his hand.
36.18: And all the vessels of the house of God, the great and the small, and the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king and of his princes--the whole he has brought in to Babylon.
36.19: And they burn the house of God, and break down the wall of Jerusalem, and all its palaces they have burnt with fire, and all its desirable vessels--to destruction.
36.20: And he removes those left of the sword to Babylon, and they are to him and to his sons for servants, till the reigning of the kingdom of Persia,
36.21: to fulfil the word of Jehovah in the mouth of Jeremiah, till the land has enjoyed its sabbaths; all the days of the desolation it kept sabbath--to the fulness of seventy years.
36.22: And in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, at the completion of the word of Jehovah in the mouth of Jeremiah, has Jehovah waked up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he causes an intimation to pass over into all his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,
36.23: `Thus said Cyrus king of Persia, All kingdoms of the earth has Jehovah, God of the heavens, given to me, and He has laid a charge on me to build to Him a house in Jerusalem, that is in Judah; who is among you of all His people? Jehovah his God is with him, and he does go up.'
